canonical_project: ByteDC Data Center (Phnom Penh City Center / PPCC)
owner: ByteDC Solutions / Urban Data Center Co., Ltd (Bytedc (KH) Co., Ltd)
notes: Cambodia's first Uptime Tier III certified (design) carrier-neutral data center, inaugurated 2023-05-11. Up to 3 MW IT capacity (DCD, B), ~81,040 sq ft built-up floor space, ~1,000 racks, at Phnom Penh City Center (Land 356 Street R-4, Srah Chork, Daun Penh). Uptime award record (A) for facility identity; capacity claim per DCD/trade press.
